rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CLVII How long the Effects of a Direction shall last
rules.historical_meaning_only: Printed CLVII starts after divider in lower original PDF688; distinct from unnumbered Effects of Directions.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: How long the Effects of a Direction shall last
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source's title asks for duration but substantive content chiefly qualifies intensity and realization.
The supposed magnitude of effects is a distinct target from whether an event occurs.
The natal Significator's strength is one required input to source magnitude.
The natal Promittor's strength is another required input, not interchangeable with significator.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or their Debility in Root of Nativity
rules.historical_meaning_only: Essential/accidental strength is evaluated at original natal root, not judged retrospectively.
Both source actors strongly dignified jointly create a favorable magnitude branch.
Both also angular is another source strength requirement in the same example.
Author alleges such source effects become observable, without operational definitions.
The maximal-strength branch alleges a full effect; no fixed real-world magnitude scale.
Lilly gives a worked interpretive example of the Sun directed to a sextile of Moon.
The Sun/Moon example specifically assumes their essential dignities.
He alleges unusual success when both directed planets meet, no validated outcome.
One strong and one weak source actor produces an intermediate claimed result.
Intermediate strength allegedly means moderate rather than maximal effects.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: observe whether Significator or Promittor better dignified
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author requires comparing which actor is stronger, rather than a single combined count.
If the Significator has higher fortitude, the source gives one branch.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Happinesse without any great weighty cause
rules.historical_meaning_only: Strong Significator supposedly permits success with relatively minor external trigger.
If Promittor is stronger, there is a different source branch.
Promittor-strong outcome alleges observable benefit, not necessarily a perfect outcome.
The result's scale allegedly differs from obvious initiating cause, a flexible source claim.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: both of them are weak in Radix
rules.historical_meaning_only: A natal-significator-and-promittor compound weak condition is a separate source branch.
The result's supposed magnitude is reduced when both source actors weak.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: occasion of Happinesse promised as poore
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author further alleges a weak/small initiating cause, distinct from outcome magnitude.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: by how much both more weak
rules.historical_meaning_only: Relative weakness is used as a graded modifier, without numerical score.
Stronger weakness allegedly reduces apparent fulfillment, not just event date.
An even stronger adverse condition is distinguished from mere partial weakness.
Lilly explicitly permits no real effect, a non-occurrence endpoint.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: onely a shadow appear nothing effected
rules.historical_meaning_only: He also permits mere apparent or trivial evidence without actual event.
This source conditional concerns Saturn/Mars as the PROMITTOR, not every malefic natal placement.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: portend an Infelicity any sad Events
rules.historical_meaning_only: Source alleges adverse effects from adverse promittors.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if in Radix they were strong
rules.historical_meaning_only: A strong natal malefic Promittor is an explicit mitigation condition.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or posited in their owne houses
rules.historical_meaning_only: Being in own domicile is another alternative source mitigation.
An apparent negative direction may supposedly yield less harm if malefic was strong.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: hurt not their owne houses or significations
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author supplies a source doctrine for own-dignity malefics as less harmful.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: worse then to doe lesse evill when well affected
rules.historical_meaning_only: Relative malefic debility supposedly increases bad effects; exact magnitude unknown.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in same yeer good and ill directions
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author explicitly anticipates contradictory directions in the same calendar year.
Opposite indications can arise from different source points, not only one.
The author recognizes uncertainty about choosing among conflicting directions.
Ordinarily both positive and negative effects may allegedly happen within one year.
Co-occurrence is allowed unless the source directs an exception, not forced choice.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: unless agreement or conveniency of them
rules.historical_meaning_only: Conflicting directions sharing the same represented domain require special arbitration.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon and Horoscope both health Body
rules.historical_meaning_only: He chooses an example where lunar and Ascendant directions refer to same health topic.
Ascendant square Mars is the adverse part of example.
The adverse example includes fiery zodiac sign condition.
Original alleges a specific disease outcome, not a validated medical forecast.
Moon sextile Venus is a competing positive direction in same year.
A lunar trine Venus is alternative positive source aspect.
The positive example additionally involves a watery sign.
The author asks for a binary outcome under contrary testimony.
An independent annual profectional figure supposedly adjudicates competing directions.
Solar/annual revolution is another alleged adjudicator, not directly same as primary direction.
If profection/revolution supports Mars, the source alleges illness.
This old medical diagnosis claim requires additional agreement; not actually reliable.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: concurrence Profection or Revolution with Venus
rules.historical_meaning_only: If annual figures instead favor Venus, positive direction is preferred.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: evade totally or little sensible Disease
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author supplies null/mild illness alternatives under Venus concurrence.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if not satisfied observe Promittors Radix
rules.historical_meaning_only: If two methods fail to settle conflict, the author introduces another fallback.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: which Promittors in Radix best fortified
rules.historical_meaning_only: He compares original natal source strength to settle remaining ambiguity.
The strongest Promittor wins if prior arbitration remains unresolved.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: both Directions partake of his influence
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author still allows both directions to reflect whichever promittor deemed stronger.
